name: The Grand Skyseer

angles.text: As a shaman, you may find an important contact in Ayessa Dawnsinger. She recognizes travelers attuned to the spirits and gifted in spiritual matters.
As a druid, you may find kindred thought among the Windshapers. They sense spiritual auras and watch subtle shifts in the skies.

faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger leads the Windshapers in Valanaar as their spiritual guide. She receives travelers at the lodge near the settlement's center, especially those who resonate with the spirits and bear the rare gift of skysight.
Ayessa Dawnsinger can be found at the Windshaper lodge near the center of Valanaar. She awaits travelers from Shen'dar Village who bring word of their recent deeds from Elder Amberwind.
faq.q: Where can Ayessa Dawnsinger be found?

faq.answer: The Windshapers are a spiritual collective in Valanaar, led there by Grand Skyseer Ayessa Dawnsinger. They study the skies and commune with the spirits, even as tensions with the High Order run high.

aliases: why high order mad at windshapers
faq.answer: The Windshapers and the High Order clash over the wind spirits. The High Order distrusts their motives and seeks to understand Skywall's powers. The Windshapers trust the elementals and take that doubt as an insult. Street violence is forbidden, especially with a cult threatening the region.
faq.q: Why do the Windshapers clash with the High Order?

faq.answer: Skysight is a rare spiritual perception found in few people of Zephras. It lets them sense spiritual auras and commune with unseen forces. Ayessa says the gift is growing rarer, making those who possess it vital in these hard times.
faq.q: What is the gift of skysight?

faq.answer: Elder Amberwind is a respected elder in Shen'dar Village. Elder Amberwind judges travelers and sends word of their deeds and spiritual resonance to Valanaar. The elder directs the worthy to Grand Skyseer Ayessa Dawnsinger.

sections.body: You arrive in Valanaar and are sent to the central lodge. There, the Windshapers gather beneath Grand Skyseer Ayessa Dawnsinger. Elder Amberwind has heard of your deeds in Shen'dar Village and welcomes you among those attuned to the spirits. Dangers press from beyond the town and within it, so tread carefully through its fragile politics.
sections.title: Arrival in Valanaar

sections.body: Peace in Valanaar hangs by a thread. The Windshapers and the High Order openly oppose one another, and street skirmishes threaten the settlement. A shadowy cult also menaces the region. Local leaders have ordered both factions to keep their distance and face this shared danger instead of fighting over territory.
sections.title: Rivalries and Looming Cults

sections.body: Grand Skyseer Ayessa Dawnsinger says skysight is growing rare among the people of Zephras. Those who arrive with a strong aura and harmony with the spirits are vital allies. The Windshapers need them as they guide their land through hard times.
sections.title: The Fading Skysight

summary: In Valanaar, the Windshapers seek travelers gifted with spiritual sight. They send you to Ayessa Dawnsinger at their lodge, while rivalries and a threatening cult strain the settlement.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Grand Skyseer
